rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial expression for being in prison or serving a prison sentence.

example.english: When I was young, I was most afraid that I would face imprisonment one day.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣最驚自己有日要坐監。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 zeoi3 geng1 zi6 gei2 jau5 jat6 jiu3 co5 gaam1

rows.note: Use this formal term when referring specifically to confinement as a legal punishment, especially in written or official contexts.

example.english: The court sentenced them to three years' imprisonment.
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 pun3 keoi5 gaam1 gam3 saam1 nin4
